title: Expressions within print (Memphis)
description:
Modifies our previous change making program to use Scanner.
This is a way for the program to get user input as the program is running,
instead of having to change values directly in the code.

lines.explanation: To use Scanner, this import statement must be included before the "public class"
This is a main method.  Program execution always starts from the main method.
Create a Scanner object named input.  You can name this object anything you want, but you have to be consistent when using it later in the program.

lines.code: // Get user input for the number of cents
System.out.println("How many cents would you like to make change for?");

lines.explanation: This line pauses the program, allows the user to enter some int input, and stores that input value into the variable cents

lines.code: // Figure out how many quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies will add up to that amount of cents

lines.explanation: cents%25 is the amount left over after taking out the quarters
cents%25%10 is the amount left over after taking out the quarters and dimes
cents%25%10%5 is the amount left over after taking out the quarters, dimes, and nickels
